# NPM Improved v1.5.0 — Full Node Analytics and Traffic Blocking

Extends the node-local Analytics Center into a detailed HTTP traffic
investigation and response console, while preserving the full existing
**per-proxy-host Analytics** pages and the v1.4.2 managed native updater.

## Detailed investigation
- Effective client IP and original peer IP (IPv4/IPv6), full user agent, request
  ID, Nginx connection ID and request number, millisecond timestamp, TLS
  protocol, HTTPS scheme, request/response sizes, status, timing and paths.
- Busiest source IPs, distinct source-IP count (not distinct people), first and
  last observed activity, top full user-agent strings and bot/automation
  classifications. Bot categories are **unverified UA claims**.
- Filtered HTTP request and connection history by source IP, user agent, bot
  category, connection identifier, route, status and reporting window.
- CSV exports include IP/agent/connection fields and match the selected
  investigation filters.
- Node traffic charts, per-host views, stream session tracking and all other
  existing analytics remain intact.

## Active blocking
- Administrator-only node-local IPv4/IPv6 and CIDR blocks.
- Literal case-insensitive user-agent substring blocks (not arbitrary regex).
- Nginx enforcement on managed proxy, redirect, 404, default and fallback HTTP
  routes; 403 results are logged with a block reason.
- Every rule is checked with `nginx -t` and reloaded immediately. Failed
  activation rolls back to the previous policy.
- Rule removal, operator audit history and opt-in signature blocks for common
  scanning tools. Common search crawlers are not auto-banned.
- NPMX shares configuration but **not** local analytics or blocking decisions.

## Retention
Detailed local raw HTTP events default to 30 days (up to 90 configurable),
aggregate rollups to 365 days. IP/user-agent information cannot be recovered
for requests recorded before this release. No query strings, passwords,
authorization headers, cookies or request bodies are collected.

## Production changes
Only the existing NPM Improved application image is updated. No helper
containers or developer debugging panels are added. Existing databases,
certificates, host analytics, NPMX settings and native updater are retained.
